Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_KnivesCanRemove: Lets a sharp knife cut upgrades off a bag when there are no scissors.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_BaseUpgradeSlot: Upgrade slots every bag has before the modifiers below.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_BackSlotModifie: Slots added to (or taken from) bags worn on the back.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_FannySlotModifi: Slots added to (or taken from) bags worn as a fanny pack, front or back.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_OtherSlotModifi: Slots added to (or taken from) every other bag, such as duffel bags and bags carried in the hands.\nA bag left with no slots after its modifier takes no upgrades, whatever the Tailoring level.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_TailoringModifi: Every this many Tailoring levels give every bag one more upgrade slot.\n0 = Tailoring gives no extra slots.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_SewingXP: Tailoring XP for Sewing On an Upgrade
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_SewingXP_toolti: Tailoring XP given each time an upgrade is sewn onto a bag. Patching clothing gives 2.\nCutting an upgrade off gives none: it always gives the item back, so it could be sewn on again for more.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_ClothCapacityPe: Share of the bag's original capacity a cloth bag upgrade adds (0.1 = 10%%), rounded down.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_ClothCapacityBo: Capacity a cloth bag upgrade adds on top of the share above.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_ClothReductionP: Share of the weight the bag does not already reduce that cloth straps remove.\nExample: 0.5 on a bag with 80%% weight reduction gives 90%%; 0.3 on a 70%% bag gives 79%%.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_ClothLootSpawns: Multiplies how often cloth upgrades and straps are found. 0 = never.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_JeanCapacityPer: Share of the bag's original capacity a denim bag upgrade adds (0.1 = 10%%), rounded down.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_JeanCapacityBon: Capacity a denim bag upgrade adds on top of the share above.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_JeanReductionPe: Share of the weight the bag does not already reduce that denim straps remove.\nExample: 0.5 on a bag with 80%% weight reduction gives 90%%; 0.3 on a 70%% bag gives 79%%.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_JeanLootSpawns_: Multiplies how often denim upgrades and straps are found. 0 = never.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_LeatherCapacity: Share of the bag's original capacity a leather bag upgrade adds (0.1 = 10%%), rounded down.
Capacity a leather bag upgrade adds on top of the share above.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_LeatherReductio: Share of the weight the bag does not already reduce that leather straps remove.\nExample: 0.5 on a bag with 80%% weight reduction gives 90%%; 0.3 on a 70%% bag gives 79%%.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_LeatherLootSpaw: Multiplies how often leather upgrades and straps are found. 0 = never.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_MilitaryCapacit: Share of the bag's original capacity a military bag upgrade adds (0.1 = 10%%), rounded down.
Capacity a military bag upgrade adds on top of the share above.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_MilitaryReducti: Share of the weight the bag does not already reduce that military straps remove.\nExample: 0.5 on a bag with 80%% weight reduction gives 90%%; 0.3 on a 70%% bag gives 79%%.
Sandbox_DynamicBackpacks_MilitaryLootSpa: Multiplies how often military upgrades and straps are found. 0 = never.
